subject.title: Track failed sync and hydration attempts

question: Should Gitcrawl adopt the failure-ledger schema and `sync-failures` JSON contract proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/gitcrawl/pull/90 after adapting it to current main's hydration model?
rationale: The missing behavior is confirmed and the candidate has real runtime proof, but durable schema placement, retry/resolution semantics, and a public agent-facing command contract require maintainer intent.

options.title: Rebase and adopt the ledger
options.body: Adapt the linked PR to current main and merge it after focused schema, legacy-read, coverage, and JSON compatibility review.

options.title: Narrow the public contract
options.body: Persist failure state internally but defer or explicitly mark the standalone command and JSON fields experimental.

options.title: Use observation-scoped tracking
options.body: Keep this issue open and replace the PR if failures should be represented through the newer run or hydration-observation model instead.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt the ledger
recommendation.body: Adapt the linked PR to current main and merge it after focused schema, legacy-read, coverage, and JSON compatibility review.

likelyOwner.reason: He most recently and extensively changed the exact hydration and schema paths into which this ledger must fit.
